toy.about: Illustrative chain-reaction toy, not reactor physics data. k = kFull(moderator) x (1 - rodAbsorb x rods): kFull rises in a straight line from kMin with no moderator to kMax with all of it (without slowing, few neutrons split U-235 in low-enriched fuel); fully inserted rods absorb rodAbsorb of the neutrons. N(g+1) = k x N(g), from N0 neutrons, for a set number of generations. Steady (critical) means k = 1 exactly; steadyBand is only a floating-point tolerance, so a setting with k = 0.999 is shown dying out.

plant.about: Prairie Town's 100 MW plant (illustrative, town.json) at the efficiency implied by EIA's 2025 weighted average tested heat rate for nuclear units. Core heat minus electricity is rejected heat plus other losses (such as the plant's own use), most of it through the condenser.
